scripts.dev:prisma-pull: npm run with-env -- npx prisma db pull
scripts.dev:prisma-init-migrate: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script > prisma/migrations/0_init/migration.sql
scripts.dev:prisma-resolve: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 0_init
scripts.dev:prisma-migrate: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate dev --skip-generate --name
scripts.dev:prisma-push: npm run with-env -- npx prisma db push --skip-generate
scripts.dev:prisma-studio: npm run with-env -- npx prisma studio
scripts.dev:prisma-seed: npm run with-env -- npx prisma db seed
